verdict.rationale: Phoenix's own docs say it accepts traces over the OpenTelemetry protocol (OTLP), is built on OpenTelemetry, and uses OpenInference instrumentation, so developers can send standard OTel traces instead of a proprietary format. The docs also describe the tracing as not tied to any specific LLM vendor or framework. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of OTLP ingestion specifically, and documented detail on OTLP endpoints/transports (gRPC vs HTTP) or exporting traces back out over OTLP.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send and receive traces over OpenTelemetry (OTLP) instead of a proprietary format

citations.quote: Phoenix offers comprehensive tracing capabilities that are not tied to any specific LLM vendor or framework. Phoenix accepts traces over the OpenTelemetry protocol (OTLP)
It is built on top of OpenTelemetry and is powered by OpenInference instrumentation.
Phoenix accepts traces over OpenTelemetry (OTLP) and provides auto-instrumentation for popular frameworks
